title: Pipeline by the numbers
caption: Do you have 27 names? That is what one deal takes in this example, 9.5 months before the money.

cycle.total: Sales cycle: {months, number} months from first lead to money

a-reference-win-rate.description: In a dataset of 655 thousand opportunities across 387 companies, the new-customer win rate was 19 percent (about 5.3 opportunities per win), the sales cycle 91 days and 8 stakeholders per deal; expansion sales to existing customers ran 45 percent, 52 days and 5 stakeholders. It is a vendor study of its own customers' CRM data [1].

ebsta-pavilion.title: Ebsta and Pavilion, GTM Benchmarks Report

the-biggest-loss-is-no-decision.header: The biggest loss is no decision
the-biggest-loss-is-no-decision.description: An analysis of more than 2.5 million recorded sales conversations found 40 to 60 percent of deals are lost to buyers who intend to buy but never act [1].

hbr-indecision.title: Dixon and McKenna, Stop Losing Sales to Customer Indecision (Harvard Business Review)

everyone-holds-a-veto.description: Sellers rarely find one person who can approve a deal alone; decision authority rests with a group whose members have different roles and all have veto power [1].

hbr-consensus-sale.title: Schmidt, Adamson and Bird, Making the Consensus Sale (Harvard Business Review)

buying-groups-disagree.description: A Gartner survey of 632 B2B buyers describes buying groups of five to 16 people; 74 percent of teams showed unhealthy conflict, and groups that reached consensus were 2.5 times more likely to report a high-quality deal [1].

gartner-buyer-teams.title: Gartner, Gartner Sales Survey Finds 74% of B2B Buyer Teams Demonstrate "Unhealthy Conflict" During The Decision Process

read-the-picture.title: Read the picture
read-the-picture.script: Read the picture. Lead to opportunity is three to one, opportunity to deal is nine to one, so together it takes 27 leads for one deal.

read-the-clock.title: Read the clock
read-the-clock.script: Now read the clock. Two weeks, six months, three months, which makes 9.5 months from first lead to money. Think one step further and ten deals need 270 leads.

backward-chain.title: Backward chain
backward-chain.script: So chain it backwards. If you want a deal in month X, count back 9.5 months, and by then you need 27 names in the funnel. Do you have 27 names?

your-numbers-not-mine.title: Your numbers, not mine
your-numbers-not-mine.script: One thing I want to be straight about: this is my worked example, not a law. Yours will be shorter or longer, which is exactly why you measure your own.
